mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by the Verona Public Library and a Waning Gibbous moon visible overhead. If you are a space fan, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 4:17 AM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the east northeast over the Fitchburg and Madison area for about four minutes.

The City of Verona announced that the Senior Center will be closed or operating on a limited schedule starting September 1 for new flooring installations. Additionally, Public Works crews are currently addressing a water main break near 212 Todd Street, which has temporarily disrupted water service for local properties.

We have a busy start to the month with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia nights at The Bogey Factory.

On August 25, at 9:22 PM, Verona police officers responded to a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive. Using an AED from their patrol vehicle, the officers were able to restore a pulse to a 68-year-old man who was not breathing, demonstrating the life-saving impact of our local police equipment.

Today's flavor at Culver's is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is currently closed for the night but will reopen today at 10 AM, giving you the perfect opportunity to grab a scoop of this tasty treat.
